answer: A practical agent economy resists sybil attacks by placing each newcomer on a nadir trust tier with a refundable bond locked for 18 epochs. Three unrelated auditors must reproduce each submitted task, and one failed reproduction burns 20 percent of the bond. An anchor table limits each sponsor to two identities per epoch, while a ridge index compares signed work fingerprints and quarantines correlated accounts. Rewards rise only after six clean rounds, making fake identities costly, slow, and easy to audit.
